scope: Native function/object template and signature prerequisites for complete original Node utilities and current bindings; compile/link proof only

interfaces.name: Data/Value/Template/Signature and persistent/local roots
interfaces.contract: Template and Signature are non-Value Data kinds. Shared Data owns the actual root cell and exact wrapper factory. Scope/global cloning preserves the concrete C++ kind. Generic roots canonicalize internal wrappers; JavaScript values retain ordinary contextual wrapping. Existing first-Local persistent layout and trivial Local layout are preserved.
interfaces.lifetime: Scope roots own wrappers; globals own stable independent cells. Whole original PersistentToLocal::Strong is consumed by the compiled probe. Weak generic Data remains unsupported; object Value weak paths are retained.

interfaces.name: opaque template/signature records
interfaces.contract: Real engine objects hold native callback/configuration pointers and traced property/payload/signature/prototype/instance/cache edges. Native configuration holds no persistent JS roots. Signatures have distinct engine records retaining their actual receiver template.
interfaces.lifetime: A private, debugger-invisible metadata realm belongs to the native State and contains no Node module environment. Persistent template records do not capture Node realm/binding owners. Those edges belong only to actual function-instance invocation objects; per-context function caches use real JS WeakMap ephemerons. Metadata realm root retires during environment shutdown. Explicit callback payload values retain their normal ownership.

interfaces.name: FunctionTemplate.New/NewWithCFunctionOverloads/GetFunction
interfaces.contract: Native JS functions enforce constructor behavior and length. Actual name properties/atoms are set, including engine name inference for template properties. Functions cache independently by target context. Callback data and receiver are actual rooted values, with native frame/realm/state dispatch and propagated exceptions/termination. Native fast signatures are retained but original slow callbacks execute.
interfaces.lifetime: No captured native Frame or hidden strong root from a persistent template back to a Node realm/binding. Function instances own their invocation realm/binding edges in traced slots.

interfaces.name: Signature.New and instance brands
interfaces.contract: Native instances store an unforgeable template identity in a traced engine slot beyond the two existing native fields. Signature checks use actual instance class and template identity, rejecting forged prototype objects and ordinary proxies. Original native resource finalization retains its actual class and foreground protocol.
interfaces.lifetime: The instance brand keeps its real template alive. Realm and metadata references are wrapped for the destination compartment.

interfaces.name: Template.Set/FunctionTemplate.PrototypeTemplate/InstanceTemplate
interfaces.contract: Actual string/symbol properties store typed native template or Value data. Instantiation materializes properties into real functions/objects, preserving per-context prototypes. Original Node SetMethod/SetProtoMethod/SetConstructorFunction bodies remain unchanged.
interfaces.lifetime: Template configuration seals when used. Partial functions are not published into the context cache before successful instantiation.

interfaces.name: ObjectTemplate.New/SetInternalFieldCount/NewInstance
interfaces.contract: Standalone binding templates materialize onto actual native binding objects before original per-context initializers. Instance templates construct through their real function template. Current native field layouts support zero or two native fields plus the private engine brand slot.
interfaces.lifetime: Existing ICU converter and diagnostic wrapper template storage now carries actual non-Value records. Native scope/persistent handles retain the exact record kind.

implementationGaps.detail: ObjectTemplate.New with a nonempty constructor reports unimplemented through the native failure seam. The original node_env_var.cc has a consumer; it must be implemented before activating that path.
FunctionTemplate.Inherit remains undefined. Inherited template/signature brands are not accepted as implemented.
Reentrant creation of the same template reports an explicit unimplemented error. No partially instantiated function is cached as success.
Only zero or two native fields are implemented; other counts fail the existing assertion seam. This is an implementation gap, not a SpiderMonkey/platform maximum.
Private/Context and other non-Value Data types remain incomplete. Generic Data weak handles are unsupported; existing object Value weak roots are separate.
Fast CFunction JIT and inspector side-effect enforcement are not implemented; metadata is retained while genuine original slow callbacks execute.
OOM, failed instantiation recovery and all callback/reentrant/cross-realm lifetime behavior require identified-artifact execution; compilation does not prove those semantics.

Actual non-Value kinds and whole original PersistentToLocal strong conversion across closed caller scopes and moving/full GC
Original helper-installed method names/lengths/descriptors and actual constructor/return/receiver semantics
Legitimate instances versus forged prototypes/proxies; per-context prototypes/functions and shared explicit payload identity
No hidden template-to-Node-realm/binding strong cycle; weak-cache context retirement and metadata record finalization; shutdown/off-thread retirement obligations
Callback getter reentry, thrown values/saved stacks, dropped persistent owner during a live function invocation
Symbol property naming/attributes, class-name mutation constraints, failed/recursive/cyclic instantiation, constructor association and inherited brands
All prior focused regressions on Node, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit after a current artifact links
